lines.3: 「I'm going back to my online game! In there, I'm a winner! People respect me!」
lines.4: 「You can play after you go to school!」
lines.7: 「I'm sorry we left you alone for so long.」
lines.9: 「Lovey-dovey couples are the second least trustworthy thing after politicians!」
lines.10: 「Yoshimi misses you when you're gone too.」
lines.11: 「Here. I've got Yoppi on my phone. Listen to her.」
lines.15: 「C-come on, Nagomi. You have to say something too.」
lines.16: 「...I would like to see your face once in a while, Senpai.」
lines.18: 「...This is not worth it unless you buy me dessert too.」
lines.20: 「Your kindness gives me strength! I have received your voices!」
lines.21: 「All right! I'll give it my best!」
lines.23: 「Though we owe Yoshimi and the others any cafeteria dish they want.」
lines.24: 「Smart Leo makes my heart go pitter-patter♪」
lines.27: 「Come on! Let's go to school... Wait! Aww, you're kissing AGAIN!」
lines.28: 「Fine! I'll make absolutely sure I find happiness too!」
lines.30: 「If we let him turn into a complete loser, Subaru would probably get mad at us.」
